title: Constructors

help.title: About Constructors
help.overview: A Constructor is a company or professional you attach to edifices and, optionally, to unit costs. This directory is contractors, architects, engineers, and similar parties — not a user account and not a building.

sections.title: What a constructor holds
items: Optional email, phone, description, website, and logo.
Optional addresses (street, postal code, city, and country are required on each address; state is optional; map coordinates are required when you add an address).
Party type: contractor, architect, engineer, quantity surveyor (QS), project manager (PM), surveyor, or other.
Trades (short free text), insurance expiry date, performance score from 0 to 100.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create a constructor — name and VAT are required.
Search and filter the list; open a row to edit identity, addresses, and scores.
Delete is a soft delete and can be restored. Deleting unlinks this constructor from edifices that listed it. Those buildings are not deleted.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Creating a constructor does not assign it anywhere. You pick it later on an edifice (optional constructors list) or on a unit cost.
Several constructors can sit on one edifice. One constructor can sit on many edifices.
Unit costs can point at one constructor as the vendor for that purchase. That link is optional.

sections.title: Typical next step
items: Create the firms and professionals you work with.
On each edifice, attach the relevant constructors.
When booking unit costs, pick the constructor if you want the invoice tied to this directory.
